info.name: Cleanora R1-P04 Customer Self-Service
info.description:
# Cleanora R1-P04 — Customer Self-Service

> **API version:** `/api/v1`  
> **Collection environments:** `Hosted (Not hosted yet)` and `Local`  
> **Prerequisite:** authenticate with R1-P02 and populate `accessToken`

R1-P04 provides authenticated self-service customer profiles, profile images,
peer text addresses, authoritative contact state, complete notification
preferences, and privacy-request intake.

## Collection Structure

```text
Hosted (Not hosted yet)
├── Profiles
├── Profile Image
├── Addresses
├── Contact and Preferences
└── Privacy Requests

Local
├── Profiles
├── Profile Image
├── Addresses
├── Contact and Preferences
└── Privacy Requests
```

Hosted requests use `{{hostUrl}}`; Local requests use `{{baseUrl}}`.

## Authentication and Ownership

All requests use the current authenticated customer:

```http
Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}
```

The API derives ownership from the trusted principal. A customer cannot supply
another user's ID to access a profile, image, address, preferences, or privacy
request.

## Profiles

Individual, Company, and Engineer profiles use separate endpoints and strict
full-replacement bodies. The authenticated identity must hold the matching
verified category. Company commercial and tax registration identifiers are
nullable profile fields.

## Profile Image

Upload/replace uses `multipart/form-data` with:

```text
file = {{profileImagePath}}
expectedAssociationVersion = {{profileImageAssociationVersion}}
```

Supported images are JPEG, PNG, and WebP up to 5 MiB. The collection captures
the latest association version from successful responses.

## Addresses

Addresses are peer text addresses; none is implicitly primary. Create captures
`addressId` and `addressVersion`. Update and delete use the current version to
prevent stale writes.

## Preferences

Preference replacement is a complete matrix. The request must include the
current version, language, reminder choices, promotional choices, and mandatory
security/active-service delivery settings.

## Privacy Requests

The API accepts `DEACTIVATION`, `DELETION`, or `EXPORT`. Submission records the
request; it does not claim that the privacy operation has already been
executed. Only a pending request may be cancelled.

## Saved Examples

Every request contains a Saved Example named `Success`. Each example includes
the original request and required body when applicable, the correct HTTP
success status, and a representative response envelope. GET requests have no
request body by design.

## Local URLs

```text
API:     http://localhost:8000/api/v1
Swagger: http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs
```
